image_description: A close-up shot of two golden-brown bagels resting on a wire cooling rack. The foreground bagel is topped with sesame seeds and features a distinct, ornate metallic band wrapped around its lower right quadrant. The background bagel is slightly out of focus but also appears to have sesame seeds. To the left, there is a blurred white package with yellow text.
